name: antcv
description: AntCV PWA React-islands build. Vite outputs a single IIFE bundle into pwa/ alongside the existing vanilla files. React and ReactDOM remain externalised — both are already loaded via UMD in pwa/index.html. See docs/plan/AntCV_Plan_v2_LockedSources.md §7 Pass 1.
comment:security: SECURITY-DEPS-001 (2026-06-13): npm audit reports 2 DEV-ONLY advisories (esbuild dev-server, via vite) — GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 + GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr. `npm audit --omit=dev` = 0 PRODUCTION vulnerabilities; the shipped app.js is built with terser, not vite/esbuild, and the vite dev server is never run in CI/prod. The only complete fix is the breaking vite-6 major, deliberately NOT taken for a dev-server-only issue. Bumped vite 5.4.11 -> 5.4.21 (patch). Re-assessed weekly per docs/security/SECURITY_UPDATE_POLICY.md.
